scope: Bilingual computer-science course PDFs, scans, photographs and visual evidence
selection_policy: Primary author papers, official repositories, official documentation, official model/dataset cards only. Latest is latest verified in these sources on the access date, not an exhaustive global ranking.
reported_result_policy: All numerical literature scores are external_reported. FYP measurements live in separate run artifacts; no score is transferred to this system.

sources.title: pypdf: Extract Text from a PDF
key_claims: Text-layer extraction cannot recognize text contained only in image pixels.
Digitally-born PDFs, scans, and OCRed PDFs have different failure modes.
limitations: A successful extract_text call does not establish page completeness, reading-order correctness, or OCR accuracy.

sources.title: MinerU releases
key_claims: 4.0.0 released 2026-09-16, replacing 3.x backend selection with flash/basic/standard/advanced tiers.
The new HTTP API is V1, and old /file_parse and /tasks are not provided.
limitations: New major release; a 2.5 model paper does not validate every 4.0 pipeline configuration.

sources.title: MinerU 4.0 Quick Start
key_claims: Python >=3.10,<3.15; practical fresh environment recommendation is Python3.12.
Native no-inference PDF extraction explicitly uses mineru-kit parse input.pdf -o output.md --tier flash --ocr-mode txt.
Apple Silicon base package includes Torch dependencies.
limitations: flash --ocr-mode txt does not add OCR for scanned pages.
Default PDF parse is standard and may download model weights.

sources.title: MinerU Tiers and Runtimes
key_claims: basic can use ONNX or Torch small models without a VLM.
Apple Silicon automatically chooses Torch/MPS small models and llama.cpp VLM.
flash OCR requires models even though native flash text extraction does not.

sources.title: MinerU README resource table
key_claims: Reported basic model download approximately0.8GB; standard/advanced approximately2GB for llama.cpp configurations.
Reported minimumRAM basic ONNX2GB; basic Torch8GB.
limitations: Download sizes exclude package runtime dependencies and are approximate upstream specifications, not local measurements.

sources.title: MinerU Open Source License
key_claims: Based on Apache2.0 with additional conditions.
Online services must visibly attribute MinerU.
Additional commercial license thresholds include over100millionMAU or over20millionUSD total monthly revenue for combined affiliates.
limitations: Model bundles and dependencies require separate license inspection.
